component.name: AcrPDF
component.summary: Open-source PDF editor and digital signing tool
Editor de PDF y firma digital de código abierto

description.p: View, annotate, fill and create forms, sign with handwritten signatures and with digital certificates (PAdES), stamp, organize pages, convert, compress, protect and redact PDF documents. Includes a virtual PDF printer.

Visualice, anote, rellene y cree formularios, firme con firma manuscrita y con certificado digital (PAdES), selle, organice páginas, convierta, comprima, proteja y censure documentos PDF. Incluye una impresora PDF virtual.
